spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6
spacing_and_layout.padding_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 for main containers. High density inside widgets.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-md (8px) for sharp, technical feel
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense data, right-align numbers in tables, top-left for North Star metric

components.navigation: Collapsible left-sidebar with high-contrast active states. Sidebar background #18181B, text #A1A1AA, active text #FFFFFF with left-border accent.
components.cards: Flat background #FFFFFF, 1px solid border #E4E4E7, NO box-shadow. Hover: border-zinc-400 transition-colors.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary: bg-[#0F52BA] text-white. Secondary: bg-white border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-900.
components.tables: Dense. border-collapse. Subdued header background (#F4F4F5), pure white rows, 1px bottom border. Hover row: bg-zinc-50.
components.charts: Recharts. Use monochrome for base lines, primary accent for utilization, danger red for overages.
components.forms: Shadcn UI customized: strict rectangular inputs, 1px borders, subtle focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F52BA]/20).

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle border color shifts, NEVER layout shifting. transition-colors duration-200.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeletal loaders for tables rather than spinners.

accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: data-testid on every button, input, tab, and row action.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus outlines required for all interactive elements.

image_urls.description: Minimal abstract layer background for the SSO login screen to provide a polished corporate feel.
Default profile picture for the logged-in user in the top right or sidebar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'IBM Plex Sans' in index.html. Do NOT use Inter.
Implement the UI using raw HTML/Tailwind for layouts and Shadcn for interactive logic (Dialogs, Selects, Tables).
Dashboard must utilize the 'Control Room' grid: dense, data-heavy, maximizing viewport space without generic cards.
Sidebar should be collapsible to maximize data table width.
Place the North Star Metric (e.g., Total Licenses Allocated) prominently in the top-left of the Dashboard.
Color is functional: Use Red ONLY for errors/reclamations, Green ONLY for active/approved. Primary Blue for CTAs.
All testable elements MUST contain semantic data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-submit').
Add 'recharts' library for the Analytics dashboard visualizations.
